patch_list: Adds a density submenu under Screen for larger text and controls, including hosted navigation apps. Choose the car's density or 160–240 DPI. Keeps resolution unchanged; reconnect to apply.
Adds an Apps card to Gearslip's phone settings. Every installed car app is ticked by default; unticking one hides its tile from the car drawer. Does not disable or uninstall apps.
Shows only the music player when an app also provides a car Settings service, including YT Music Morphe. Uses Gearslip's existing docked player.
